name: TOSSS
description: TOSSS (Two-Option Secure Snippet Selection) is a software security benchmark that measures LLMs' ability to choose between secure and vulnerable code snippets based on CVE database vulnerabilities, providing an extensible framework for evolving security evaluation.
reputation: A new security-focused benchmark that is likely to be used in code-safety evaluation, but it is not yet broadly established as a standard community benchmark.
notes: Evaluates LLMs on C/C++ and Java code snippets; security score ranges from 0 to 1; aims to complement existing benchmark scores.
